name: Fractal Mandala Visualiser
note: No sign-up, 45 minutes per visitor. Needs WebGL; the control panel is in Italian.
noteIt: Nessuna registrazione, 45 minuti per visitatore. Serve un browser con WebGL.

session.clock: wall clock from first entry, on the server; resumable inside the window
session.keyedOn: random id in a durable HttpOnly cookie, plus 3 sessions per IP per UTC day as a backstop
session.firmness: soft: a private window gets another session, and the source is public on GitHub under MIT
session.store: demo_sessions table, SQLite (node:sqlite) on the demo-data volume
session.atEnd: the open tab reloads onto the server's 'La demo è finita' page, which names what they saw and links the Noein contact page; the app files stop being served to that session; no restart
session.cleanup: nothing to delete (an entry makes nothing on the server); identity rows are purged lazily after retentionDays

tiers.decidedBy: owner, 2026-09-17: a server-enforced 45-minute session rather than no time box; the full version at / behind a password so the limit cannot be stepped around; everything inside the demo open, since nothing costs per use

data.source: none: every image is computed in the visitor's browser from the parameters in the URL hash
data.refresh: Nothing to refresh. The seeded first view is SEED in demo/demo.js, copied from «Giardino di smeraldo» in NAMED_PRESETS.

killSwitch.note: In /opt/sites/fractal/.env. False, or unset, and the site goes back to what it was before the demo: the whole visualiser public at /, no password, no clock, and /demo redirecting to /.

resets: Rendering runs entirely in the visitor's tab, so one visitor cannot touch another's view. «Ricomincia» on the banner puts the seeded view back (Ctrl+Z undoes it); saved views and padlocks, which live in that browser's localStorage, are kept.
costPerVisit: none beyond serving about 130 KB of files; the rendering runs on the visitor's GPU
